newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on speculation in dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on speculation in dlrs.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed low against the dollar on Thursday due to speculative demand for dollars, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.20 to the dollar after opening at 58.15 and moving to a low of 58.30, they said.
"The rupee, which fell to 58.30 due to aggressive buying of dollars by a speculator, recovered a little when a state bank sold dollars," said a Deutsche Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates, which opened at 11 percent, closed at 13 percent after moving up to 13.5 percent as a number of banks covered positions on squaring up day, dealers said.
"Call rates were volatile also beause banks are long on dollars," said the Deutsche Bank dealer.
